name: Rajgad Fort
tagline: The Maratha empire's first capital — a sprawling fort you can't finish in one visit
seoTitle: Rajgad Fort Solo Trek Guide — The Solo Trail
seoDescription: Solo trekker's guide to Rajgad Fort near Pune — route options, the Rajgad-Torna range trek, safety, and packing.

seasons.label: Jun – Sep
seasons.sub: Monsoon — lush but steps get slippery

seasons.label: Mar – May
seasons.sub: Hot and exposed on the ridge

routeOptions.name: Via Pali
routeOptions.notes: Shorter and steeper — the more popular day-trip route from Pune.

safety.intro: Rajgad is a large fort complex with several sub-peaks (Padmavati Machi, Sanjeevani Machi, Suvela Machi) — it's easy to underestimate how much walking is involved once inside.

cards.title: Before you go
items: Plan for a full day — the fort complex is large and easy to under-time
Carry more water than you think you'll need; little shade on the ridge

cards.title: On the trail
items: Some rock-cut steps near the Padmavati Machi gate are narrow and slippery when wet
Turn back before dark — descent in low light is genuinely harder than the climb

cards.title: Solo-specific
items: Popular weekend trek — you'll usually find other trekkers around
If continuing to Torna as a 2-day range trek, tell someone your full plan, not just day one

items.name: 2.5–3L water — limited refill points on the fort
Energy snacks for the full-day exploration
Trekking pole for the steeper Pali approach
Headlamp as a backup in case descent runs late

gettingThere.intro: Reached via Nasrapur on the Pune–Satara road, then a shared jeep to Gunjavane.

steps.title: Pune to Nasrapur
steps.body: From Swargate depot in Pune, board any ST bus heading toward Satara or Kolhapur and alight at the Nasrapur bypass (~1.5 hrs).

steps.title: Nasrapur to Gunjavane
steps.body: Shared jeeps and tempos ply from Nasrapur to Gunjavane village (~40 min), the most popular base for the Chor Darwaza route. Direct Swargate–Gunjavane buses exist on paper but run very infrequently — don't plan around them.

steps.title: Alternative: via Pali village
steps.body: For the Pali Darwaza route, take an ST bus to Velhe and continue by shared taxi or on foot via Pabe village, crossing the Kanad river to reach Pali.

steps.title: Trek and return timing
steps.body: The climb from Gunjavane takes roughly 2.5–3 hrs. Shared vehicles from these base villages become scarce after about 4pm — plan your descent to reach the village well before then.

gettingThere.permitNote: No formal entry fee — this is forest-department land, not a ticketed monument. Occasional small parking charge at the village.

transport.note: Per person; ₹500–800 for a full jeep

onTrail.note: Optional — the trail is reasonably well-marked
Basic meals before or after the trek
